slots.section_title: Physical Architecture of Diffractive Neural Layers: From Diffractive Lenses to Trainable Optical Networks
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Clarify how diffractive optical layers map to neural network computation, showing the diffraction integral as the weight operation and illustrating the transformation from digital weight matrices to spatially varying phase profiles.

slots.section_title: Training Paradigms for Optical Diffractive Networks: Gradient-Based Learning, End-to-End Optimization, and Physics-Aware Algorithms
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Show the complete training pipeline for ODNNs, making explicit where the physical diffraction model enters the forward pass and where backpropagation traverses the physical layers, clarifying the end-to-end optimization loop.

slots.section_title: Hardware Realization of Diffractive Neural Networks: Phase Modulation Platforms, Fabrication Techniques, and Reconfigurability Trade-offs
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Compare hardware platforms for ODNN realization along orthogonal axes of resolution, bandwidth, reconfigurability speed, power consumption, fabrication cost, and stability, enabling readers to quickly assess trade-offs.

slots.section_title: Wavelength Multiplexing and Spectral Bandwidth in Diffractive Optical Networks: Multi-Wavelength Computation and Chromatic Constraints
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Illustrate how chromatic dispersion causes the same diffractive network's transfer function to change across wavelengths, showing both the limitation (chromatic degradation) and opportunity (wavelength multiplexing for multi-task processing).

slots.section_title: Applications of Diffractive Neural Networks: Imaging, Classification, Segmentation, and Pattern Recognition
Controversies and Unresolved Debates in Diffractive Neural Network Research
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Map the active controversies in ODNN research onto a two-dimensional space of evidence strength versus consensus level, helping readers understand which disputes are mature enough for resolution and which require new methodologies.

slots.section_title: Bottlenecks and Future Trajectories for Diffractive Neural Networks: Toward Hybrid Electro-Optical Systems and Scalable Optical AI
slots.intended_reader_takeaway: Present a challenge roadmap prioritizing bottlenecks by severity and projected resolution timeline, synthesizing the review's findings into an actionable research agenda for hybrid electro-optical co-design and scalable optical AI.
